checks: Final 50-page Astro build and all 44 site tests passed. Bundle validation passed: 518 concepts and 1691 local links; register validation passed: 114 records and 52 events. Whitespace check passed.

No horizontal overflow on ten sampled pages at measured 390 CSS px and seven at measured 320 CSS px. Additional checks used measured widths 1146, 1669, 2149 and 2866; requested emulation widths are not reported as measured widths.
Food + Mayurbhanj returns Mudhi Mansa; impossible search returns an empty state and reset action. Keyboard focus moves to invalid contribution fields and journey import controls.

Illustrated download reported four included photographs. A separately generated 827388-byte synthetic HTML sample loaded four embedded photographs, contained zero script elements and retained a long note ending LAST-LONG-NOTE.
Print emulation shows print content and hides interactive journey UI; long-note end marker retained. Native PDF unavailable.
Temporary Review only — illustrated Odisha book journey deleted through UI. Original empty My Odisha Journey preserved.
Public issue URL is encoded and length-limited; long Unicode drafts use complete copy/paste fallback rather than truncation. No issue submitted.
Image creator, licence, source, modification and hash records maintained. New Commons photographs visually inspected.
limitations: Native PDF generation reports Printing is not available. A4 pagination and physical printing remain unverified; print-media DOM checks are not PDF verification.
Physical devices, assistive screen readers, and comprehensive accessibility conformance have not been tested.
Founder editorial review and native-language/community review remain pending. Food origins are attributed accounts; no vendor, property or local access inspection is claimed.
The photo download control was exercised, but browser-downloaded bytes were not independently retrieved. A separate synthetic sample from the same production helper was opened and visually inspected.

GitHub repository public visibility and enabled Issues were verified read-only. No test issue was posted. Issue templates and website changes are local candidates, not installed on the default branch or publicly deployed.
Self-review by the implementing assistant, not independent review. No push, merge, release, payment or new hosting service.
